_comment: Plan 073: signal health digest. thresholds in seconds; hints are one line each, keyed <signal>.<reason>. Rows in state ok carry no hint. Plan 077: hints name Settings labels, never config keys or plan numbers.

hints.session_log.unconfigured: game install folder not set or not found - see Settings > Game folders
hints.session_log.log_dir_missing: no game Log folder yet - launch the game once; EW reads the folder it creates
hints.session_log.watcher_stalled: game watcher stopped polling - restart the server (tray > Restart server)
hints.session_log.quiet: no session log line for a while - normal on a loading screen; else check Settings > Game folders
hints.session_log.silent: logged in but the session log is silent - check Settings > Game folders, then restart the server
hints.session_log.game_closed: game closed - a quiet log is expected
hints.screenshots.unconfigured: Documents folder not set or not found - see Settings > Game folders
hints.screenshots.folder_missing: no ScreenShot folder yet - take one screenshot in game; EW reads the folder it creates
hints.ocr.disabled: auto-OCR paused by a config file switch - resumes within 24 h; clear it from the top-bar badge
hints.ocr.error: OCR failed on the last shot - check the Windows OCR language pack (System > OCR)
hints.ocr.backlog: screenshots waiting for OCR - they drain one at a time; restart the server if stuck
hints.ocr.game_closed: game closed - no screenshots to read
hints.notices.disabled: notice check paused by a config file switch - back on at the first server restart after 24 h
hints.notices.robots_disallow: official site disallows our reader in robots.txt - notices paused (expected)
hints.notices.robots_unreachable: official robots.txt unreachable - retried later; check your connection
hints.notices.failing: official notice fetch failing - retried with backoff; check your connection
hints.notices.stale: no good notice fetch in 2 days - open Events to retry
hints.market.empty: market watch is empty - add items on the Market tab
hints.market.blocked: arsha.io endpoints blocked (Imperva) - stale prices shown, retried with backoff
hints.market.stale: no fresh market price in 6 h - open Market to refresh
hints.profile.no_family: no family name set - Settings > Profile > Family name
hints.profile.no_base: profile off: public API disallows robots - Settings > Profile > Self-hosted profile API base
hints.profile.robots: profile host disallows robots - profile paused (expected)
hints.profile.stale: profile cache is stale - refresh retries in the background
hints.profile.error: profile fetch failing - check the family name and base URL in Settings > Profile
hints.boss_drift.not_built: no drift check yet - runs after the next schedule fetch
hints.boss_drift.drift: boss table differs from the public schedule - review Events > World bosses
hints.boss_drift.error: boss schedule drift check failed - retried later
